passives.C_CTR: CTR→2.2nF C0G→GND，工作全角有效1.98–2.42nF；FH 0603CG222J500NT/C2991172 与Cff同SKU
passives.C_POR: move original C_DUMP_DRV_HF to 12V_HW/GND; share between UCC and TPS only if physically close and local bypass requirements are met
passives.C_HOLD: 12V_ANALOG_HOLD -> two 22uF C49118556 -> GND, effective >=10uF per bank; placed close enough to satisfy REF supply 1-10uF effective and comparator supply
passives.C_REF: REF_2V5→GND_SYS，1µF有效起并满足REF5025稳定条件；C_NR/其他引脚依原候选且须具体核对
passives.C_ANALOG_BYP: one shared 100nF analog hold -> GND close to REF/TLV1811; actual layout and ESR must meet both
passives.early_ready: 12V_PROT -> R_READY_LED 1.8k -> READY_LED_A; READY_LED_K -> Q_READY_LED.C, Q_READY_LED.E -> GND_SYS; GUARD_OK -> R_READY_BASE 1k -> READY_BASE; Q_READY_HW and its series drive resistors excluded; independent HW_READY does not gate early ready
passives.old_isolator: 12V_PROT -> 1.8k -> OLD_LED_A; VO617A.2 -> DUMP_OFF_LEGACY; original 10k 12V_PROT pullup and Q_PMOS_CTRL kept
passives.LDO_INPUT: BUS_EXT -> 160mA UMT-H 3403.0266.23 -> BUS_FUSED; FET source impedance, DC interrupt and fusing coordination pending
passives.LDO_FEEDBACK: 12V_SRC -> 84.5k 0.1% -> LDO_ADJ -> 10k 0.1% -> GND_SYS; 2.2nF C0G from 12V_SRC to LDO_ADJ
passives.POWER_GATE: UCC OUTH -> 10Ω -> GATE_DUMP; UCC OUTL -> 10Ω -> GATE_DUMP; 10k GATE_DUMP -> GND_SYS

release_blockers: J_EARLY_READY reflects only early GUARD_OK; separate HW_READY is local UCC enable. BMS early receiver and post-PRE HW status slow coordination remain unresolved.
REF5025 start-up maximum and allowed brownout/recovery not guaranteed by fixed delay; qualification needed.
Old-domain VO reverse voltage and full-corner input/output leakage and timing not established; new node static and transient budget open.
Independent LDO startup current, BUS precharge burden, fuse clearing and supply hold are not proven.
Precise capacitors, additional circuitry and hardware-only net BOM including original change are not fully specified; verify source in official EDA.
User owns resistor power/thermal implementation; provide electrical waveform, no power rating selection by agent.
validation_handoff: Human bench: cold/slow start, brownout/short dip and restart with 12V, REF, HW_READY, DUMP_OFF_HW, MOS VGS and resistor current synchronized.
Human bench: calibrated threshold full window, 0.5ms current rise, 92us ideal release comparison and battery current; measured line and sensor conditions.
Human bench: 12V_PROT on/off with BUS-side supply valid, VO LED forward/reverse and both comparator requests; early READY signal and BMS receiving behavior.
Post-PRE HW_READY may be coordinated over CAN only after safe hardware-to-MCU sensing and fresh-state contract; this cannot replace local fast protection or FOC hardware REGEN_PATH_OK.
